Message:
When my friend and I
discovered that tiny bud,
we were practically
jumping for joy.

It was the first bud of
a new species of flower
we’d been caring for together.

What color would it be?
Would it be single-flowered
or double-flowered?
What would it smell like?

My friend and I let
our imaginations run wild
as we gently stroked
the latent bud.

It doesn’t matter what
color or shape you take.
You have a safe place right here.
So, bloom away without worry.

While stroking the bud,
I noticed something
on the back of my hand.

When I brushed it off,
it fell to the ground
with a soft plop.

It looked a bit like a flower,
but...what was it?
